headline: Bangladeshi youth shot and injured in Rohingya camp over debt dispute
summary: A young man was shot while demanding payment of outstanding money in a Rohingya refugee camp in Ukhiya, Cox's Bazar.
details: A Bangladeshi youth was shot and injured in a Rohingya refugee camp in Ukhiya, Cox's Bazar, after a dispute over unpaid debts.
The incident occurred when the victim was attempting to collect outstanding money from someone within the camp.
Following the shooting, the injured youth was rushed to a nearby hospital for emergency medical treatment.
Local authorities are investigating the incident to determine the exact circumstances and identify the shooters.

headline: Water levels rise: 11 rivers flow above danger mark in Bangladesh
summary: Rising water levels in multiple rivers have sparked fears of flooding in residential areas as water threatens to overflow.
details: Water levels in 11 rivers across Bangladesh have risen above the danger mark, creating a high risk of flooding in nearby residential areas.
Authorities are monitoring the situation closely as the water levels continue to climb, threatening to breach embankments and enter local settlements.
The rise in water levels is attributed to heavy rainfall and upstream water flow, which has already put pressure on the river systems across several districts.
Local residents in low-lying areas are being urged to remain vigilant as the risk of flooding increases with the possibility of more rain in the forecast.
